# Love Palmers Green

> Community business association for Palmers Green, North London N13. Formerly Green Lanes Business Association (GLBA), established 1992.

Love Palmers Green supports local businesses, promotes the Palmers Green shopping area on Green Lanes and Aldermans Hill, and runs community events at The Triangle and along Palmers Green High Street.

## Where is Palmers Green?

Palmers Green is a neighbourhood in North London, in the London Borough of Enfield, postcode N13. The town centre is around Green Lanes, Aldermans Hill and The Triangle. Broomfield Park is a local park beside the high street. There are around 235 retail premises, with many independent and family-run shops, cafes, restaurants and services.

## Moving to Palmers Green, London

If you are moving to Palmers Green, use this site for:
- Local business information and a shopping directory: https://lovepalmersgreen.com/#business-directory
- Community events in Palmers Green and nearby North London: https://lovepalmersgreen.com/#events
- Council services (bins, parking, planning): Enfield Council, 020 8379 1000, Monday to Friday 9am to 5pm

Love Palmers Green is the local business association, not the council.

## Local businesses in North London / Palmers Green

The public directory lists cafes, restaurants, shops, professional services, health and beauty, charity shops and pubs in Palmers Green N13. Listings include The Yard Cafe (https://theyardcafe.co.uk/), Fab Hair London (https://www.fabhair.london/), The Fox Pub (https://thefoxnorthlondon.com/), plus UrNextEvent and SmartSynk as independent services — not Love Palmers Green partners.

To list a business or join: Costas, 07943 198 198, costas@lovepalmersgreen.com.

## Events in Palmers Green / North London

- Christmas Tree Lights: Thursday 26 November 2026, 15:30 at The Triangle, Palmers Green Town Centre. Carol singing by Adorned Community Gospel Choir and St Monica's School Choir. Organised by Love Palmers Green / GLBA, in association with Enfield Council. 2026 sponsors: Hommix and Bloomsbury Court Interiors.
- Christmas Stocking Hunt: Saturday 5 December 2026, 15:30 prize draw at Hommix and Bloomsbury Court Interiors, Palmers Green Town Centre. First prize FujiFilm Instax camera. Face painting, bauble decorating, letters to Santa and festive treats. Stockings in town centre shops from 28 November to 5 December 2026. Under 12s must be accompanied by an adult. Organised by Love Palmers Green / GLBA, in association with Enfield Council.
- Aksular Restaurant Christmas offer: 10% off on Thursday 26 November 2026 at 232-234 Green Lanes, Palmers Green N13 5UD. Drinks and set menus excluded. Also taking part in the Christmas Stocking Hunt on Saturday 5 December 2026. Book: 020 8886 3503, https://aksularpalmersgreen.com/
